title: The Ark of the Covenant
summary: A chest of acacia wood overlaid with pure gold, 2.5 by 1.5 by 1.5 cubits, with a lid of pure gold (the mercy seat) and two gold cherubim on it.

parts.label: The ark (chest)
parts.note: Length, breadth and height are given in cubits, in acacia (shittim) wood overlaid with pure gold within and without. The thickness of the wood and of the gold is not given.

facts.text: Made of shittim (acacia) wood

quote.kjv: an ark of shittim wood
quote.bsb: an ark of acacia wood

facts.text: Overlaid with pure gold, inside and out

quote.kjv: overlay it with pure gold, within and without
quote.bsb: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out

facts.text: Bezalel made it to the same measure

quote.kjv: two cubits and a half was the length of it
quote.bsb: two and a half cubits long

quote.kjv: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof
quote.bsb: two and a half cubits long

quote.kjv: a cubit and a half the breadth thereof
quote.bsb: a cubit and a half wide

quote.kjv: a cubit and a half the height thereof
quote.bsb: a cubit and a half high

gold.note: The gold's thickness is not given. Drawn as a thin skin over the wood.

parts.label: Crown of gold
parts.note: A crown of gold "round about" is stated; its profile and height are not. Drawn as a plain rim around the top edge.

facts.text: A crown (molding) of gold around it

quote.kjv: a crown of gold round about
quote.bsb: a gold molding around it

facts.text: Bezalel made it

quote.kjv: made a crown of gold to it round about
quote.bsb: made a gold molding around it

parts.label: Four rings of gold
parts.note: Four cast rings, two on each side, are stated. The Hebrew word the KJV renders "corners" (pa'am) is often read "feet", as the BSB does, so they are drawn low on the chest by default; some place them at the top corners.

facts.text: Four rings of cast gold

quote.kjv: cast four rings of gold
quote.bsb: Cast four gold rings

facts.text: Two on one side, two on the other

quote.kjv: two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it
quote.bsb: two rings on one side and two on the other

facts.text: Bezalel cast them

quote.kjv: he cast for it four rings of gold
quote.bsb: he cast four gold rings

quote.kjv: four rings of gold
quote.bsb: four gold rings

inset.note: How far each ring sits from the end of the chest is not given.

choices.label: Low, at the feet
choices.note: Reads the Hebrew pa'am as "feet" (the BSB's "its four feet").

height.note: A ring's centre above the floor; not given.

choices.label: At the top corners
choices.note: Reads it as the KJV's "four corners", placed high so the ark rides above the bearers' shoulders.

height.note: A ring's centre above the floor; not given.

parts.label: Staves (poles)
parts.note: Acacia overlaid with gold, carried in the rings and never taken out. Their number, length and thickness are not given, nor whether they run along the length or the breadth. Shown as two staves of 4.5 cubits along the length.

facts.text: Acacia wood overlaid with gold

quote.kjv: staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold
quote.bsb: poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold

facts.text: Put through the rings to carry the ark

quote.kjv: put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark
quote.bsb: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark

facts.text: Never taken out of the rings

quote.kjv: they shall not be taken from it
quote.bsb: they must not be removed

facts.text: Bezalel made them and put them in

quote.kjv: he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark
quote.bsb: He inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark

count.note: Not stated; one stave for each side's pair of rings.

parts.label: The testimony
parts.note: The testimony goes inside the ark. Exodus 31:18 calls it two tables of stone; their size is not given. Hebrews 9:4 adds the pot of manna and Aaron's rod. Turn on See inside.

quote.kjv: put into the ark the testimony
quote.bsb: place inside the ark the Testimony

quote.kjv: two tables of testimony, tables of stone
quote.bsb: two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone

facts.text: Also the pot of manna and Aaron's rod

quote.kjv: the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded
quote.bsb: the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded

quote.kjv: two tables
quote.bsb: two tablets

parts.label: Mercy seat
parts.note: Pure gold, 2.5 by 1.5 cubits, set above on the ark. Its thickness is not given.

quote.bsb: a mercy seat of pure gold

parts.label: Two cherubim
parts.note: Stated in the text: beaten gold, of one piece with the mercy seat, one at each end, wings stretched on high covering the seat, faces toward one another and toward the seat. Interpretive: the kneeling posture, faces, robes and feathers follow artistic tradition, not the text, and so does their height.

facts.text: One at each end, of one piece with the mercy seat

height.note: Not given. The figures' height, to the top of the wings, follows artistic tradition.

parts.label: Between the cherubim
parts.note: The text names the place: above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim. The soft light is only a visual cue.
